rows.grounds: verb know; third plural present active
candra + gata; feminine accusative singular modifying rucim

items.question: Which beings know the beauty of moon-rays?
premises: Only cakora birds know moon-ray beauty.
items.inference: Knowledge of moon-ray beauty is exclusive to cakora birds.
uncertainties: candragatāṃ may mean moon-residing rather than moon-ray.
items.plain_english: Only cakora birds know the beauty of the moon-rays; no others do.
